# Kosmos Prototype Notes

**Generated by Cursor agent.**

Scope: this prototype validates the **architecture hypothesis** (structured world model coordinates literature + analysis agents). It does **not** validate Kosmos discovery quality at production scale.

References:

- Robin: [Nature s41586-026-10652-y](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10652-y)
- Kosmos: [arXiv:2511.02824](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02824)

---

## §1 Validation Results

Smoke runs on 2026-06-06:

| Run | Mode | Cycles | Outcome |
|-----|------|--------|---------|
| `20260606T080233Z_d8afeec1` | `kosmos_wm` | 1 | `nucleotide_salvage` → **supported**; claim `C1` links `E1,E2,E3` |
| `20260606T080234Z_2be2dfa6` | `no_world_model` | 3 | Same tasks repeated each cycle; **no supported claims** |

### Success criteria

1. **WM convergence** — PASS. Literature finding `F1` + analysis finding `F2` jointly support `nucleotide_salvage`.
2. **Claim traceability** — PASS. `C1` → `E1/E2` (snippets `snip_001`, `snip_002`) and `E3` (analysis JSON under `cycle_0/`).
3. **Ablation drift** — PASS. Without WM, planner re-issues `lit_nucleotide_salvage` + `analysis_group_diff` for all 3 cycles because the 200-char summary cannot encode `completed_task_ids`.

### Verdict

The minimal loop demonstrates that a **structured world model** is load-bearing for task deduplication and cross-agent hypothesis promotion. Robin-style summary pass-through collapses to repetitive phase-1 tasks and never ingests findings into a shared graph.

## §2 Gaps to Full Kosmos

### Architecture

| Gap | Kosmos | This prototype |
|-----|--------|----------------|
| World model | Production structured graph (schema undisclosed) | 4-node JSON in memory |
| Agents | Edison literature + data analysis agents | Keyword stub + pandas |
| Planning | WM query + LLM/heuristic, ≤10 parallel tasks | Rule planner, 2 serial tasks/cycle |
| Scale | 20 cycles / 200 rollouts / ~12h | 1–3 cycles / ≤6 tasks |

### Capabilities

| Gap | Kosmos | This prototype |
|-----|--------|----------------|
| Code execution | Jupyter sandbox, ~42k LOC/run | Fixed pandas script |
| Literature | ~1500 full papers/run | 5 curated snippets |
| Statistics | MR, SHAP, enrichment, multi-omics | Group mean diff only |
| Reports | 3–4 paper-grade reports, 79.4% expert accuracy | Half-page markdown |
| Provenance | Notebook trajectories (`r7`, etc.) | Local JSON refs |
| Domains | 7 case studies | 1 toy metabolomics |

### Engineering

- No worker pool, checkpoint/resume, or cost accounting
- No WM drift detection or contradiction resolution
- No reproducibility bundle (Docker, data hashes, pinned environments)
- No wet-lab interfaces
- Kosmos itself is not open-sourced; relies on Edison commercial APIs

### Gaps vs Robin (predecessor)

- No lab-in-the-loop experiment design or validation
- No Falcon-style pairwise hypothesis tournament
- No Crow/Finch production literature or analysis depth

## §3 Improvements Beyond Kosmos

Priority: **P0** = near-term architecture wins; **P2** = longer-horizon research.

### P0 — Auditable world model (3.1)

Kosmos hides its WM schema; synthesis statements are only 57.9% accurate. Ship an explicit **provenance graph** (entity–finding–evidence–claim) with append-only versioning and a **contradiction check** on every ingest.

### P0 — Two-step IR (3.2)

Separate LLM planning (`TaskIR` narrow schema) from deterministic execution (literature/analysis materializers with Pydantic validation). Reduces untraceable failures inside monolithic rollouts.

### P0 — Uncertainty on claims (3.3)

Attach `confidence` and `evidence_grade` (primary / derived / speculative) to each claim. Require ≥2 heterogeneous evidence sources before promoting synthesis claims.

### P0 — Stats linter (3.7)

Block ingest of `supported` findings when analysis violates sample-size, distributional, or multiple-testing assumptions (Kosmos cases include KS misuse and unstable heavy-tail fits).

### P1 — Reproducibility manifest (3.4)

Export `run_manifest.json` with data hashes, planner version, and per-cycle WM snapshots; ship first-class ablation switches (`kosmos_wm` / `no_world_model` / `no_synthesis`).

### P2 — Formal planner (3.5)

Model open hypotheses as a bandit/POMDP over information gain; add WM-saturation stop criteria instead of fixed 12h runs.

### P2 — Companion memory bridge (3.6)

Persist discovery WM into a long-lived research persona for one human partner (Inty `MEMORY.md` sub-domain), compacted by maintenance ticks across campaigns.
